title: Tim NDE 90
content: Woke in bed with massive pain, more than I ever dreamed possible. Felt like something pulled me out of bed. Saw and felt a mist and a blackness in a ring around me. Like a hyperspace on the periphery.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Illness Full rupture of appendix with massive peritonitis. Had appendix rupture.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Darkness | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.At what time during the experience were: It was as much as can be had with that level of sheer pain.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I felt time stretching, dissolving, moving in a different direction.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain Kind of like 'gorgons'. Dark shadowy figures.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Felt like I was in a moist landscape. Kind of like 'Dagobah' the planet that 'Yoda' lives on in that Star Wars movie.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Release, catharsis. Some bit of psychedelic perhaps.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I felt that I had gotten some heightened awareness. I can foreshadow events now. They aren't always clear. But I get these hunches and concepts that I invariably experience later.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw all my bad and unhealthy habits. Saw my ways of dealing with people socially, etc.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future See above.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes See above. I also seem to be more telepathic, clairvoyant perhaps.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best -- getting the 'wake up call'. Worst -- the pain. The NG tube in my nose. Losing the muscle mass from laying on the hospital bed for two weeks while antibiotics were pumped into me. I had severe convulsions at one point because of toxins in my body. that was HELLACIOUS -- whew!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Shock, weird-out, horror. Some stopped talking to me, called me a freak.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: That song by 'Jewel' 'Only Kindness Matters' is really hitting the lesson I learned on the nail-head. That thought of only being 'cool to all people' is the lesson that seems to have been programmed in my head.
